SELECT l.DNA, typeof(l."DNA-II") AS level_type, MIN(l."DNA-II") AS lowest, MAX(l."DNA-II") AS highest, COUNT(*) AS visits
FROM Laboratory AS l
WHERE l.DNA IS NOT NULL OR l."DNA-II" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY l.DNA, typeof(l."DNA-II")
ORDER BY visits DESC
LIMIT 30

FROM Laboratory AS l

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(NULLIF(l.DNA, '') AS REAL) < 8
LIMIT 1
